contract.command: /tempban-list [page:1..10000]; default page one; ten complete rows per page except the final page. Read-only ephemeral Ban Members-class moderation command, not a new self/member lookup or reconciliation verb.
contract.states: pending due/future, staged expiry associated with a prepared ban, running, quarantined and a pending row with dispatch_uncertain. Preserve their distinctions; terminal done/cancelled/superseded history excluded. Standalone prepared permanent-ban intents without a saved expiry are outside this inventory.
contract.order: Saved execute_at ascending, then stable member/work identity; tests accept either lexical direction across the opposing member/work tie fixture but reject permuted insertion order. Publish the chosen tie key. Complete work and member IDs remain associated on each row.
contract.privacy: Current server-side actor authority, configured guild/moderation gates, no member-self authority, private reply/defer completion, suppressed mentions, complete finite content <=2000 UTF-16 units, no reasons/claim capability/raw errors/foreign guild data. Saved/due does not prove Discord unban; running is not completion.
contract.spies: Real router/runtime/executor/store; route-aware loopback authority fixture. SQLx executed-query receipts require scoped ordered LIMIT queries and <=11 returned rows including lookahead; malformed selectors and rejected authority require no expiry/ban reads. Full snapshots of five moderation ledgers plus nontransactional statement-write probes catch attempted claims/sweeps/repairs/audits, including zero-row or rolled-back writes. An independent read-only pool must still serve inventory. REST allows authority GETs and the one private interaction answer only, never bans lookup or guild mutations.
contract.coverage: All actual saved-work states, foreign and terminal rows, 24-row three-page fixture with ties and permuted insertion, default/repeat page identity controls, page 0/-1/10001/i64::MAX, string/bool/nested/duplicate/unknown/action selectors, inclusive 10000, stale ordinary/missing/cold actor, guild/DM/moderation/missing actor fences, empty vs out-of-range vs closed-pool query failure, hostile work identity and withheld hostile reasons.
contract.limits: This is not a concurrency-snapshot promise or a live Discord/database test. The upper-bound page test validates decode/read behavior on a small fixture, not a 100000-row load test. Query receipts bound materialized rows, not PostgreSQL scan cost. Existing sweep/mutation tests are not changed. No schema, runtime source, activation, policy, permission or CI changes.
